sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 17 May 2026, pitch SYN-SYNCP000037-P1 was put before Atlantic Health Network 037 on behalf of SANOFI.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 2 rebate of 4 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Tdap minimum take of 810 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer came back with a counter.
